<!-- SVG viewer container -->
<div id="pathogen-svg-container" style="margin-top:20px;">
  <img id="pathogen-svg-viewer" src="" alt="Pathogen SVG" width="100%" style="max-height: 800px;">
</div>


<script>
const pathogens = Array.from(
  document.querySelectorAll("#pathogen option"),
  option => option.value
);
console.log(pathogens);

const getSvgUrlByVirus = (pathogen) => {
  // Define your base URL
  const baseUrl = "https://dholk.primate.wisc.edu/_webdav/dho/projects/lungfish/InfinitePath/public/%40files/heatmaps/by_virus";
  // Format: baseURL/city-pathogen.svg
  return `${baseUrl}/${pathogen}.svg`;
}

const updatePathogenSvg = () => {
  const pathogen = document.getElementById("pathogen").value;
  const svgUrl = getSvgUrlByVirus(pathogen);
  document.getElementById("pathogen-svg-viewer").src = svgUrl;
}

const updatePathogenSvgViewer = () => {
  const virus = document.getElementById("pathogen").value;
  const virus_url = getSvgUrlByVirus(virus);
  document.getElementById("pathogen-svg-viewer").src = virus_url ;
}

function preloadPathogenSvgs(pathogens) {
  for (const pathogen of pathogens) {
    const url = getSvgUrlByCity(pathogen);
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = url ;
  }
}

document.getElementById("pathogen").addEventListener("change", updatePathogenSvg);

window.onload = () => {
  updateCitySvgViewer();
  updatePathogenSvgViewer();
  preloadCitySvgs(cities);
  preloadPathogenSvgs(pathogens);
};
</script>

## Pathogen Abundance By City

```{=html}
<!-- Dropdowns for city and pathogen -->
<label for="city">City:</label>
<select id="city">
  <option value="Chicago_IL" selected>Chicago</option>
  <option value="Boston_MA">Boston</option>
  <option value="Columbia_MO">Columbia, MO</option>
  <option value="Riverside_CA">Riverside, CA</option>
  <option value="Boise_ID">Boise, ID</option>
</select>

<!-- SVG viewer container -->
<div id="city-resp-svg-container" style="margin-top:20px;">
  <img id="city-resp-svg-viewer" src="" alt="City Respiratory SVG" width="100%" style="max-height: 800px;">
</div>
<div id="city-enteric-svg-container" style="margin-top:20px;">
  <img id="city-enteric-svg-viewer" src="" alt="City Enteric SVG" width="100%" style="max-height: 800px;">
</div>

<script>
const getSvgUrlByCity = (city) => {
  const respiratory_url = `https://dholk.primate.wisc.edu/_webdav/dho/projects/lungfish/InfinitePath/public/%40files/heatmaps/by_city/${city}/respiratory.svg`;
  const enteric_url = `https://dholk.primate.wisc.edu/_webdav/dho/projects/lungfish/InfinitePath/public/%40files/heatmaps/by_city/${city}/diarrheal.svg`;
  return [respiratory_url, enteric_url];
}

const updateCitySvgViewer = () => {
  const city = document.getElementById("city").value;
  const [respiratory_url, enteric_url] = getSvgUrlByCity(city);
  document.getElementById("city-resp-svg-viewer").src = respiratory_url;
  document.getElementById("city-enteric-svg-viewer").src = enteric_url;
}

const cities = ["Chicago_IL", "Boston_MA", "Columbia_MO", "Riverside_CA"];

// After updating, pre-load all SVGs into the browser cache so that the viewer is
// initially slow but later fast
function preloadCitySvgs(cities) {
  for (const city of cities) {
    const [resp_url, ent_url] = getSvgUrlByCity(city);
    const img1 = new Image();
    img1.src = resp_url;
    const img2 = new Image();
    img2.src = ent_url;
  }
}

// Hook up event listeners
document.getElementById("city").addEventListener("change", updateCitySvgViewer);

</script>
```
